note: results[file/profile@MaxStreamingBitrate#AudioStreamIndex]. 20 s progressive 640x360 fixtures, keyframe every 72 frames, synthetic. src lists the streams as PlaybackInfo reports them (MKV bitrates are Jellyfin guesses). ffmpegVideo and ffmpegAudio are the -codec:v:0 and -codec:a:0 of the ffmpeg command Jellyfin logged; ffmpegLog is the log kind (Remux: both streams copied; DirectStream: video copied, audio encoded; Transcode: video encoded).
